name: Alcohol
description: Containing a hydroxyl group (-OH) bonded to a carbon atom

name: Aldehyde
description: Containing a formyl group (C=O with H)

name: Ketone
description: With a carbonyl group bonded to two carbon atoms

name: Ester
description: Derived from carboxylic acids and alcohols

name: Ether
description: With an oxygen atom connected to two alkyl or aryl groups

name: Amine
description: Derived from ammonia by replacement of hydrogen atoms

name: Amide
description: Containing a carbonyl group linked to a nitrogen atom

name: Nitro group
description: Containing nitrogen bonded to two oxygen atoms

name: Halide
description: Containing fluorine, chlorine, bromine, or iodine

name: Aromatic ring
description: Cyclic compounds with delocalized pi electrons (benzene-like)

name: Phenol
description: Aromatic compounds with a hydroxyl group attached to a benzene ring

name: Sulfide
description: With a sulfur atom bonded to two carbon atoms

name: Azide
description: With three nitrogen atoms bonded together
